$comment: THE EDITABLE STORYBOARD. 24 shots cut to the measured 106 BPM / 60-bar grid in beatmap.json. Every start/end lands on a bar line. Edit action/expression/camera/caption; keep character_ref for consistency. Expressions are drawn only from the 9 in the LUNA character sheet. `lyric_lines` is generated by scripts/align_lyrics.py — do not hand-edit it. `caption` and lyric subtitles are two different things: captions are designed visual title cards, lyric subtitles come from lyrics/lyrics.srt. Where both fall on the same shot (e.g. S05), the caption wins and the lyric subtitle yields. Compile with scripts/build_shots.py.

defaults.style_suffix: anime cel-shaded, clean line art, K-pop MV aesthetic, neon backlight, cinematic lighting
defaults.negative: extra fingers, deformed hands, inconsistent hair color, changed outfit, text artifacts, watermark, multiple characters

shots.camera: extreme close-up on closed eyes, slow push-in
shots.action: darkness, a single cold rim light traces LUNA's profile; she is perfectly still, eyes closed
shots.sync: no bass (0.12x) - hold on stillness, let the pad breathe

shots.camera: wide, high angle, static
shots.action: she stands alone at centre stage, tiny in an empty dark arena, chains on her skirt catching a faint violet glint
shots.sync: airy pad only - emptiness is the point

shots.camera: medium close-up, 3/4, slow tilt up
shots.action: her eyes snap open on the last beat before the bass, violet iris catching light
shots.sync: 1 bar - land the eye-open exactly on 0:11.81

shots.camera: low angle full body, fast dolly-in
shots.action: BASS HITS - every stage light snaps on behind her at once, silhouette blowing out to full colour, ponytail lifting
shots.sync: HARD CUT on bass entry (+5.5 dB). The first real impact.

shots.camera: orbit around her, medium full shot
shots.action: first dance hook - sharp arm snap on each downbeat, camera circling 90 degrees
shots.sync: downbeats at 16.34 / 18.60 / 20.86 - snap poses on each
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.camera: tracking side profile, walking
shots.action: arrangement thins out; she walks a neon-wet city street at night, reflections rippling under her platform sneakers
shots.sync: bass drops to 0.62x - pull back to narrative

shots.camera: close-up on face, shallow focus, handheld drift
shots.action: she glances up at something off-frame, city bokeh swimming behind her
shots.sync: vocal band peaks - hold the face

shots.camera: over-the-shoulder, rack focus to background
shots.action: she turns; a colossal holographic billboard across the street is playing her own face back at her
shots.sync: rack focus on the bar line at 32.19

shots.camera: insert, extreme close-up on the hologram
shots.action: the projected face glitches - scanlines tear, colour channels split apart
shots.sync: 1 bar stinger

shots.camera: low angle close-up, slow rise
shots.action: she lifts a hand toward the fracturing hologram, light fragments drifting between her fingers
shots.sync: air band rising to 1.15x - riser begins
shots.caption: 那真的是我嗎？

shots.camera: medium close-up, push-in, whip-pan out on last beat
shots.action: her hand closes into a fist; violet energy gathers around her as the riser peaks
shots.sync: riser tops out at 45.77 - whip-pan is the cut

shots.camera: full body hero shot, low angle, fast push-in
shots.action: CHORUS - she points straight down the lens, stage exploding into neon particles and strobes behind her
shots.sync: HARD CUT on chorus downbeat. First true peak (0.64).

shots.camera: wide, crane down over dancers
shots.action: full choreography, backup silhouettes in formation behind her, light sticks flooding the pit
shots.sync: mid band 1.36x - widest frame of the chorus

shots.camera: tight close-up, static
shots.action: she winks and throws a peace sign, sparkle bloom across the frame
shots.sync: 1-bar punch-in

shots.camera: steadicam figure-8 through the stage, continuous
shots.action: longest continuous take - she moves downstage through light beams, crowd roaring on both sides
shots.sync: 8 bars sustained. Use the model's max clip length here.

shots.camera: back view, wide, slow rise to crowd
shots.action: seen from behind, arms spread to an ocean of glowing light sticks
shots.sync: hi/air climbing to 1.28x

shots.camera: rapid 4-cut montage, 1 bar each
shots.action: quick-fire pose cuts: hair flip / footwork / chain swing / chin lift
shots.sync: air peaks 1.44x at 1:10 - fastest cutting in the film

shots.camera: slow lateral track, medium
shots.action: lights drop to a single warm wash; she walks the empty stage as the arrangement thins
shots.sync: mid pulls back to 0.90x

shots.camera: close-up, soft focus, static
shots.action: she catches her breath, a small private smile, sweat catching the light
shots.sync: hold - the calm before the dropout

shots.camera: slow orbit, medium close-up, near-black frame
shots.action: BASS VANISHES - everything cuts to darkness but a single overhead beam; she stands alone, hologram shards dissolving around her
shots.sync: bass 0.39x falling to 0.02x. The emptiest bar in the track.

shots.camera: extreme close-up on eyes, hold, then snap to black
shots.action: at total silence her eyes lift to the lens, decision made; frame cuts to black on the last beat
shots.sync: 1:30 is the absolute floor (bass 0.02x). Silence = power.

shots.camera: full body, low angle, explosive push-in then orbit
shots.action: EVERYTHING RETURNS AT ONCE - pyrotechnic light burst, full choreography, maximum energy
shots.sync: HARD CUT. Highest novelty score in the track (0.86).
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.camera: multi-angle chorus block, cut every 2 bars
shots.action: sustained final chorus - alternating hero shots, crowd wides, and close-ups on each 2-bar line
shots.sync: loudest sustained passage. 7 internal cuts at 4.53s intervals.

shots.camera: final hero pose, slow pull-back to wide, hold
shots.action: peak energy at 2:00, then the bass collapses at 2:09; she holds the last pose as lights fall away, CSFCCA logo flare on the final hit at 2:12
shots.sync: Track peak then collapse. Final transient (0.96) at 132.9 - cut to logo there.
shots.caption: See you on the next stage.
